subject: Immediate: East US2 service impact — playbook activation & exec note
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>
To: oncall@redwood.example, michael_grant@redwood.example, neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, lauren_bishop@redwood.example
Date: 2027-12-05T06:12:00Z
Subject: Immediate: East US2 service impact — playbook activation & exec note

Team,

We're seeing a sustained p95/p99 latency increase and elevated 5xx rates for several high-throughput routes serving NovaFinance in eastus2 starting ~06:00 UTC. Customers are reporting timeouts and a few throttles. Frontline incident page shows increased queue depth on eastus2 inference pods.

Quick facts:
- Observed window: 05:50–06:10 UTC spike, continuing
- Symptoms: p95 generation latency ~2.1s -> 4.8s, p99 ~3.8s -> 9.6s; 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 2.7%
- Impacted routes: /v1/generate (NovaFinance logical routing), embedding batch jobs for analytics clients on same AZ

Immediate asks:
1) Michael — confirm current mitigation step (are autoscale/evacuation triggers firing?) and post a short status.
2) Neha — please open an urgent support case and request NovaFinance contact ASAP; capture their latest request and SLAs.
3) Marissa & Lauren — FYI for account exec and potential customer outreach / credit discussion. Rishi — pinging for exec visibility.

I'm attaching the eastus2 runbook snapshot (first pass) and a diagnostic snapshot I'm pulling now. We'll use the playbook below if the issue persists >20 minutes:
- verify autoscale health
- drain unhealthy nodes and shift traffic to westus2 on a best-effort basis
- enable temporary per-customer rate caps for affected tenants

I'll post updates in the thread every 10 minutes.

Diego
Director, SRE
Redwood Inference

[attachment: eastus2-runbook.pdf (PDF)]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.example>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>, oncall@redwood.example
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: 2027-12-05T06:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Immediate: East US2 service impact — playbook activation & exec note

Diego — looking now. Quick notes:
- Autoscaler shows several scale cycles, but some pods are stuck in CrashLoopBackoff when warmups hit heavy KV cache miss patterns.
- Control-plane reports high GC pauses on a small subset of older GPU instances (driver v510). We've flagged 3 nodes as "unstable" and started cordon/drain.
- Current mitigation started: partial drain of 12 pods, redirecting new session creation to westus2 for routes where policy allows.

Estimated timeline: 12–18m for drain, 25–35m for steady-state if traffic redistribution succeeds. If drain stalls due to pods failing lifecycle, will need rolling restart of the pool (add ~30m).

Action items being executed:
- Neha: ticket and customer contact (please include observed metrics below)
- Ops: preparing traffic-shift PR: https://console.redwood.example/run/shift-12345

I'll push logs and a short diag blob shortly (attaching diag_snapshot_1205.log).

—Michael
Principal SRE
[attachment: diag_snapshot_1205.log (LOG)]

From: Karen Li <karen.li@novafinance.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>, support@redwood.example
Date: 2027-12-05T06:27:10Z
Subject: Re: Immediate: East US2 service impact — playbook activation & exec note

Diego / Marissa,

We're seeing a major impact on our end — our payment ingestion flows are failing and analytics backfills are timing out. Our SRE dashboard shows p99 ~10.2s and several HTTP 504s in the last 10 minutes. This is affecting our end-of-day processing window, which started earlier than normal today.

Can you confirm:
- whether NovaFinance can be moved immediately to westus2 (we are multi-region capable but prefer a clean guided shift),
- whether Redwood can provide final timestamps for when retries will succeed (we need SLA guidance),
- and whether you will provide credits for this outage window?

Please escalate to leadership — this is customer-impacting.

Karen Li
Head of Platform Engineering, NovaFinance
karen.li@novafinance.com

[attachment: novafinance-latency-chart.png (PNG)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.example>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-12-05T06:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Immediate: East US2 service impact — playbook activation & exec note

Marissa / Lauren — Karen is asking for immediate region shift and SLA guidance. Please prepare:
- a short exec note (1 paragraph) we can send to Karen and their executive team with timeline and next steps
- proposal for a goodwill credit (suggested: pro-rated credits for the impacted window; draft amount TBD by finance)

Operational update:
- Michael's team has cordoned 3 unstable nodes and is draining 12 pods; traffic-shift PR is ready for a controlled shift of NovaFinance production traffic to westus2.
- We'll do a phased shift: 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 10–12 minutes with canary checks at each step. If errors spike >1% absolute, we'll stop and rollback.

Neha — please open the support case (include logs and current p95/p99 snapshots) and add NovaFinance contacts. Also post the HubSpot deal link for reference.

Rishi — flagging for exec visibility; happy to sync live if you want a 10m call.

Diego

Diego / team — draft executive note below. Short, factual, and actionable. Please review and approve quickly so we can send to Karen and their leadership.

DRAFT EXEC NOTE (please do not edit in-thread):
Redwood Inference is actively mitigating a service degradation impacting NovaFinance in the eastus2 region. Our SRE team has identified unstable nodes that are contributing to elevated latency and error rates. We are executing a phased traffic migration to westus2 to restore normal performance and will monitor closely. Expected timeline to return to normal service is ~25–40 minutes depending on pod health. We will provide a post-incident report and propose pro-rated service credits for the affected window.

Recommended credit: pending finance, propose 10% of the impacted-day usage for the affected routes as a gesture of goodwill.

If approved, I'll send this and include the attached runbook excerpt and a link to the current support ticket.

—Lauren
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.example>
Cc: Karen Li <karen.li@novafinance.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Immediate: East US2 service impact — playbook activation & exec note

Update:
- Traffic shift completed to westus2 following the phased plan. Canary checks passed at 20% and 50%. At 100% we observed p99 drop to ~1.2s and 5xx rate back down to 0.15%.
- NovaFinance confirmed successful reroute and backlog processing resumed.
- Support case created: JIRA-RED-1893 (linked). HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-4578 included on case.

Attachments: runbook snapshot and diag logs for post-incident analysis. I'll schedule a PIRT and post-incident review tomorrow at 11:00 PT.

Thanks everyone — will follow up with a post-incident timeline and RCA notes.

Neha Kapoor
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
